versions.changelog:
Faceless Video Automation 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI无脸视频频道自动化系统.
- Supports end-to-end automation for faceless video production: hot topic discovery, AI scriptwriting, voiceover, scene matching, subtitles, and multi-platform adaptation (B站/YouTube/抖音).
- Enables batch video creation (5-10 per day) with scripts and assets tailored for different genres and video platforms.
- Integrates a self-learning module to continually improve output quality and adapt to user preferences over time.
- Outputs complete sets of editable materials: scripts, voiceover texts, image keywords, subtitles, cover texts, and publishing plans.
